parameters.name: MediaId
parameters.description:
The media asset ID, which is the video ID. You can obtain the ID by using one of the following methods:
- For videos uploaded through the console, log on to the [ApsaraVideo VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose **Media Files** > **Audio/Video** to view the video ID.
- When you call the [CreateUploadVideo](~~55407~~) operation to obtain the upload URL and credential, the video ID is the value of the VideoId parameter in the response.
- After the video is uploaded, you can call the [SearchMedia](~~86044~~) operation to query the video ID, which is the value of the VideoId parameter in the response.

parameters.name: WorkflowId
parameters.description: The workflow ID. Log on to the [ApsaraVideo VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose **Configuration Management** > **Media Processing** > **Workflow** to view the ID.
